caption: The drawing features three distinct circular objects arranged in a triangular composition. At the bottom center is a detailed illustration of a gold pocket watch with a white face displaying black Roman numerals, two black hands, a smaller seconds subdial at the 6 o'clock position, and the brand name "Elgin" printed near the center. The pocket watch has a gold case and a loop at the top for attaching a chain. In the upper left, there is a circular object colored in shades of yellow and gold, decorated with a floral pattern, leaves, and a geometric shield-like design in the center. In the upper right is another circular object, depicted in shades of gray, white, and light blue, with intricate mechanical details including gears, screws, and inscriptions such as "Elgin Nat'l Watch Co." and "U.S.A." The three objects are drawn on a plain, light beige background.
title: Gold Watch Frame and Case
